Definition: {to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)}
BiblicalUsage: In Daniel the herald cries aloud the king's command to worship the golden image, and in Ezra the king's letter is read aloud before him. The same word carries a command to bow and a letter to be heard.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every voice that cries aloud is either calling people to bow to an image or reading the word of a king, and I know which voice I answer.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
